reviews.rationale: Figure 6 visibly shows the model input path: a user prompt ('Tell me about gene.') feeding LLM-BFT, then the generated text being converted to embeddings. That is concrete, readable evidence of a text prompt as the actual model input for the gene-set analysis route. The other displayed figures are downstream results or unrelated evaluation plots, so they do not support the remaining routes.
